title: eleusine indica var. stricta
intro: Eleusine indica var. stricta, commonly known as Cogon grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is a perennial grass that is native to tropical and subtropical regions, and is often used as a medicinal herb due to its various health benefits. The health benefits of Cogon grass include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Cogon grass include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities.
